core.title: Hager 4 x 4 Half Surface Plain Bearing Hinge,  Hager 11734P

text.description_html:
Hager 4" x 4" x Square Corner Commercial Half Surface Hinge

Commercial grade half surface standard weight door hinge with plain bearings. Five knuckle hinge with non-rising removable pin for use on regular weight hollow metal or wood composite doors and doors requiring low frequency service. Primer finish.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.129" (Commercial Grade)
  • Beveled Surface Leaf
  • Reversible
  • Plain Bearing
  • USP Primer Finish
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Steel Hinge Pin
  • Machine Screws Door Leaf: #10-24 x 1-3/4" OH"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2" FH
  • Thru-bolts and grommets for wood door applications
  • Conforms to ANSI A8433
  • Hager 11734P Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually
